caption:
Your faith became a to-do list — and your heart went dry. You learned what to do before you ever knew who He is. (Galatians 1:15-16 devotional)

You put “what do I do?” first — show up, serve, give, keep the rules — and your heart dried out. But on the Damascus road Saul asked “Who are you?” before “What shall I do?”; being comes before doing. God set you apart and revealed His Son before you did a thing, so you don't work to be loved — you're already His, and love is simply the response.
